usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: EUR 1 = USD 1.1172 on 30 October 2026, so about EUR 0.895 per US dollar; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Statistics Portugal (INE), CPI flash estimate, October 2026
inflation_cpi.note: CPI annual rate estimated at 3.8% in October 2026 (3.6% in September), released 30 October 2026; core inflation 2.8%, energy 17.4%. World Bank 2025 average 2.3%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% inflation target; Portuguese HICP 2021-2025 average 3.8% (ECB ICP)
inflation_projection.note: Portugal shares the ECB's 2% target, but inflation averaged 3.8% over 2021-2025 and is 3.8% now on an energy shock, so planning uses 2.5%, a little above the target.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank, key ECB interest rates (deposit facility)
policy_rate.note: Portugal uses the euro; ECB deposit facility rate 2.50% (main refinancing 2.65%) since 16 September 2026, unchanged on 31 October 2026 (ECB data portal FM.D.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by Banco de Portugal): Portuguese banks, overnight euro deposits from households
savings_account_rate.note: Average rate on household overnight (current and savings) deposits was 0.04% in August 2026 (0.03% in July).

fdr_3m_rate.note: Banco de Portugal and the ECB publish household term deposits up to 1 year as one bucket (1.62% in August 2026); no separate 3-month average was found.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by Banco de Portugal): household euro deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year, new business
fdr_1y_rate.note: Bucket covers all fixed terms up to one year (1.59% in July 2026); 1-2 year deposits paid 1.49% and over 2 years 2.04% in August 2026.

dps_rate.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product with a published average rate was found for Portugal.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by Banco de Portugal): household deposits with agreed maturity, all maturities, new business
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: Weighted average rate on new household term deposits of all maturities was 1.63% in August 2026; the average on all outstanding household term deposits was 1.11%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.sourceName: IGCP (Portuguese Treasury and Debt Management Agency), Certificados de Aforro interest rates for November 2026
sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Gross rate for new subscriptions of savings certificates Série F fixed at 2.500% for November 2026 (published 30 October 2026); the rate follows money-market rates and is capped, with loyalty premiums in later years. Certificados do Tesouro (7-year stepped-rate treasury certificates) are also sold to individuals.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Portugal 3-month bill yield (secondary source)
tbill_91d_rate.note: 3-month yield 2.65% on 30 October 2026. Secondary source: the IGCP publishes auction amounts but its September 2026 bill auction was for a 12-month line only.

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Portugal 5-year note yield (secondary source)

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Portugal 10-year government bond yield (secondary source)
tbond_10y_rate.note: 10-year yield 3.80% on 30 October 2026; the ECB long-term convergence yield for Portugal was 3.85% in September 2026 (ECB IRS dataset).

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Portugal income determination
tax_bank_interest.note: Interest on Portuguese bank current and savings accounts is taxed at a flat 28% for residents, withheld at source (page reviewed 3 October 2026); residents may opt to add it to income taxed at 12.5-48%.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Portugal income determination
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest is taxed at the flat 28% rate; the page does not name savings certificates separately, and Certificados de Aforro interest is withheld at the same 28% rate.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: European Commission, deposit guarantee schemes (EU rules)
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EU rules guarantee deposits up to EUR 100,000 per depositor per bank; in Portugal the cover is paid by the Fundo de Garantia de Depósitos (its own site could not be read).

credit_card_rate_cap.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics (reported by Banco de Portugal): Portuguese banks, extended credit card credit to households
credit_card_rate_cap.note: Typical rate, not the legal cap: average 16.07% in August 2026. Banco de Portugal also sets a quarterly maximum APR (TAEG) for credit cards, which could not be read.

equity_return_low.sourceName: PSI index 9,276 on 30 Oct 2026, up 10% in a year and still below its 2000 peak (Trading Economics); after-tax 3-month bill 1.9%
equity_return_low.note: Low case: European shares disappoint and earn only a little more than after-tax government bills.

equity_return_base.sourceName: PSI index history (Trading Economics); after-tax 3-month bill 2.65% x 0.72 = 1.9%
equity_return_base.note: Base case: about 3.6 points over the after-tax safe rate; Portuguese savers mostly hold diversified European and global funds, and the PSI's long record is weak (still below its 2000 peak).

equity_return_high.sourceName: PSI index history (Trading Economics), near its highest level since 2008
equity_return_high.note: High case: diversified euro equity funds keep close to their strong 2016-2026 returns.

gold_return_low.sourceName: Gold USD price history (Trading Economics); EUR 1 = USD 1.1172 (ECB, 30 Oct 2026)
gold_return_low.note: Low case: gold stalls after the 2025-26 spike and the euro firms against the dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: Gold USD price history (Trading Economics); ECB 2% target
gold_return_base.note: Base case: gold roughly keeps up with world inflation plus a little, with no trend in the euro-dollar rate.

gold_return_high.note: High case: a repeat of gold's strong 2005-2025 trend in euro terms.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: Household deposits up to 1 year 1.62% less 28% tax = 1.2% (ECB MIR)
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: after-tax bank term deposits only.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Certificados de Aforro Série F 2.50% less 28% tax = 1.8% (IGCP)
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: savings certificates and government bills after the 28% tax.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in medium and long government bonds at today's yields.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The insurance supervisor (ASF) publishes market statistics, but no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio was found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover (often tied to mortgages) is sold in Portugal, but no regulator or official premium table per sum insured was found; only individual company quotes exist.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Hospital care in the National Health Service (SNS) is free or nearly free; no official figure for the out-of-pocket cost of a major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: Private health insurance is widely sold in Portugal, but no published premium table per EUR 100,000 of cover from a regulator or public source was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket spending was 28.2% of current health expenditure in 2024 (latest available; older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Portugal, health: 2.8% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices rose 2.8% in 2025, a little above general HICP (2.4%); planning uses 3.5%, one point above general inflation, because medical costs rise faster over long periods.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: Eurostat/ECB HICP Portugal, education: 4.2% year on year in December 2025
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rose 4.2% in 2025, well above general inflation; planning uses 4%.

life_expectancy.note: Life expectancy at birth 81.85 years for 2023-2025 (men 79.22, women 84.26), released 30 October 2026. UN WPP via georank gives 82.9 for 2026.

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects via georank.org; Statistics Portugal (INE) life tables 2023-2025
life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years from georank's expected age at death by current age (UN WPP 2026 estimate). INE's own 2023-2025 table gives 20.19 years at 65 (men 18.49, women 21.55).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 40.0 (2025, World Bank), 55.0 (2040) and 56.0 (2065, populationpyramid.net/portugal/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Portugal (July 2026)
retirement_age_default.note: Normal pension age is 66 years and 9 months in 2026 (66 years 7 months in 2025), the same for men and women. It is reset each year in line with life expectancy at 65, so someone born after 1975 will likely face a higher age; it is lowered by 4 months for each year of contributions beyond 40.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Portugal (July 2026)
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants (CGA scheme, and the general scheme for those hired since 2006) follow the same normal pension age, 66 years and 9 months in 2026.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: after-tax deposits with some rate cuts.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: 3-month government bill 2.65% less 28% tax = 1.9% (Trading Economics); Certificados de Aforro 2.5% less tax = 1.8%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case: kept at the after-tax rate on savings certificates, just below the after-tax government bill rate.

retirement_return_high.sourceName: 5-10 year government bonds 3.4-3.8% less 28% tax (Trading Economics)
retirement_return_high.note: High case: medium and long government bonds bought at today's yields and held to maturity.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: After-tax deposits 1.2%; PSI and euro equity record (Trading Economics)
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 5.5% and half safe fixed income at about 1.8%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Equity high 8%; after-tax long government bonds 2.7%
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Portugal (July 2026)
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Social old-age pension (pensão social de velhice): the guide gives the social pension amount as EUR 262.40 a month. Means-tested; pensioners with low resources at pension age can also claim the Solidarity Supplement for the Elderly (CSI) on top.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Portugal (July 2026)
old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Residents at the normal pension age (66 years 9 months in 2026, men and women) without a contributory pension or with one below the social pension, and with gross income of at most EUR 214.85 a month (single) or EUR 322.28 (couple), 40% and 60% of the IAS.

gratuity_rule.note: The Labour Code gives compensation only when the employer ends the contract (dismissal for economic reasons or expiry of a fixed-term contract), not on retirement or resignation; no official page stating the current days-per-year scale could be read.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: European Commission, Your social security rights in Portugal (July 2026)
public_pension_scheme.note: Compulsory earnings-related general social security pension: normal pension age 66 years 9 months in 2026, at least 15 years of registered earnings; pensions are updated each 1 January by a formula based on GDP growth and average CPI (excluding housing), and are taxed as income.

dps.note: No standard monthly recurring-deposit product; regular saving is usually done through savings accounts or savings certificates.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: Government savings certificates sold by the IGCP through post offices, citizen shops and online (AforroNet); variable capped rate with loyalty premiums. Certificados do Tesouro are a 7-year alternative.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by the IGCP in 3- to 12-month lines; individuals buy them through a bank or broker.

equity_fund.note: Retail mutual funds and exchange-traded index funds are widely available; retirement savings plans (PPR) carry tax relief.

gold.note: Buying physical investment gold is legal and VAT-exempt under EU rules.

centralBank.name: Banco de Portugal
centralBank.note: Part of the Eurosystem; monetary policy set by the European Central Bank.

insuranceRegulator.name: Autoridade de Supervisão de Seguros e Fundos de Pensões (ASF)

insuranceComplaints.name: ASF consumer area (complaints about insurers)
insuranceComplaints.note: Complain to the insurer first; then to the ASF or a consumer arbitration centre.

pensionScheme.name: Segurança Social (Social Security Institute), old-age pension

oldAgeAllowance.name: Pensão social de velhice and Complemento Solidário para Idosos (Segurança Social)
oldAgeAllowance.note: Means-tested non-contributory pension and supplement, claimed from Social Security.
